raw_segments.text: She was even more dreadfully fond of Estella than she had been when I last saw them together.
I repeat the word advisedly, for there was something positively dreadful in the energy
She hung upon Estella's beauty, hung upon her words, hung upon her gestures, and sat
mumbling her own trembling fingers while she looked at her, as though she were devouring
the beautiful creature she had reared.
